app.name: Ciclomapa
app.one_liner: An open platform to democratize access to bike maps of Brazilian cities by combining OpenStreetMap data with an intuitive web interface.

screens.name: City Cycling Map Viewer
screens.purpose: Display interactive, simplified cycling infrastructure data for any Brazilian city using mirrored OpenStreetMap data.
primary_actions: Click to edit map data directly in OpenStreetMap
Download GeoJSON data with one click
Select a Brazilian city to view its cycling infrastructure

rust_commands.name: export_geojson
rust_commands.purpose: Generate and serve GeoJSON representation of current city's cycling infrastructure from Firebase mirror.

rust_commands.name: update_osm_mirror
rust_commands.purpose: Manually trigger a refresh of the Firebase mirror from OpenStreetMap to ensure data freshness.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add one-click GeoJSON export functionality
week 1: Implement city selector and map rendering with simplified OSM tags
week 1: Integrate direct link to OSM editor for selected features
week 1: Set up Firebase mirror schema for OSM cycling data
acceptance_tests: Clicking 'Edit in OSM' opens correct location and feature in OpenStreetMap editor.
GeoJSON download button produces valid file containing all visible cycling features.
Manual update command successfully refreshes Firebase mirror from latest OSM data.
User can select any Brazilian city and see its cycling infrastructure rendered with semantic colors.
